fire: On the hill above town, three tall cranes lifted steel beams all morning.

For dessert the café served thin crêpes with lemon and sugar.
Sous le microscope, les cristaux de sel brillaient comme du verre.
Le gouvernement a promis de sortir le pays de la crise avant l'été.

Mélangez le sucre avec la crème jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse.
The pastry was so crumbly that it fell apart in my hands.
quiet: On the hill above town, three tall trucks lifted steel beams all morning.
Le médecin a examiné le bras du patient après la chute.
For dessert the café served thick cream with lemon and sugar.
Under the microscope, the crystal of salt glittered like glass.
The government promised to lift the country out of crisis before summer.
Astronomers mapped a single crater near the lunar south pole.
The chef mixed the sugar with the cream until it was smooth.
The pastry was so crisp that it cracked in my hands.

predictions: Fires on ' cr' only where the tokenizer splits it off as its own piece; whole-token cr- words (crisis, crowd, create, cream, crime) stay near zero.
